lines.text: The biggest thing that founders are dealing with is they know they need to deal with security, but they don't know what they need to do and when they need to do it.
A founder and a CEO, their main thing is prioritization and then growth for the company.
They don't want to be mixed up dealing with security this and security that.
With security, you can boil the ocean.
You don't want to boil the ocean when you're a startup.
You want to get enough security so that you're protecting your data, your customers' data, and then also enabling businesses as well.
That's where I come in and help.
Figure out, okay, what do we need to do now?
And what do we need to do tomorrow?
What do we need to do day zero, day one, day two?
I understand the startup mindset in that perspective.
